logp.method_description: Buffer/n-octanol distribution coefficients (D) were determined using the shake-flask method. A UV–vis calibration curve was produced in the range 10–100 µM in Tris-HCl/EDTA buffer (pH 7.40) (10% DMSO added to support solubility in aqueous medium) to determine the molar absorptivity. The determination was carried out at pH 7.4 in a 1:1 mixture of buffer and n-octanol, continuously shaken for 4 h at room temperature. The concentration of each complex in buffer was measured spectrophotometrically, and molar absorptivity was used to identify the concentration after the extraction. Then, D was calculated (where D = [compound]n-octanol/[compound] in buffer). Each compound was measured at least twice, and the reported value is the average [24].
